channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japanese hospital performs world-first surgery using heart muscle stem cells
item.description: Sheets of muscle cells derived from regenerative products known as iPS cells were transplanted into the heart of a patient in her 50s.

item.title: Disaster response an ‘urgent issue,’ says new land minister
item.description: Disaster response is an "urgent issue," Ibayashi said, adding that the prime minister has instructed Cabinet ministers to prioritize countermeasures.

item.title: Burnham says Britain could rejoin the EU after next election
item.description: The remarks are the first time since the exit referendum a decade ago that a prime minister has suggested to take the country back into the EU.

item.title: For Japan’s young singles, romance gets a corporate middleman
item.description: Young Japanese exhausted by dating apps are embracing a corporate reinvention of traditional matchmaking.

item.title: While calling voice a protected right, court dismisses voice actor’s AI case
item.description: Kenjiro Tsuda's lawsuit was the first in Japan filed over a "voice rights" infringement using generative artificial intelligence.

item.title: Pay a fee, skip the line: More Japan restaurants introduce fast-pass services
item.description: One service has been adopted by 104 stores in 20 prefectures across Japan as of Sept. 18, according to its operator.

item.title: After 35 years in the country, Toys R Us plans to exit Japan
item.description: Toys R Us-Japan currently runs a total of some 150 Toys R Us toy stores and Babies R Us baby goods stores across the nation.

item.title: As Takaichi cites lack of sleep, report offers ways to ease burden on Japan PMs
item.description: An LDP official used the think tank report, which included comparisons with other countries, to argue Japan's parliament demands more of its leader's time.

item.title: GIC acquires 16 Marriott-run hotels in Japan amid tourism boom
item.description: In the latest big real estate deal in Japan, Singapore's GIC took over Four Points Flex by Sheraton, a mid-price-range hotel chain.

item.title: Japan’s health cost caps rise, widening gaps between insurers
item.description: Japan's health care system is often held up abroad as a model of universal coverage, but universal does not mean uniform.

item.title: Japan’s output falls for second month due to impact from quake and Iran war
item.description: Wednesday's data suggest Japanese manufacturers may be feeling the impact of a major quake that hit Kyushu and the Iran war.

item.title: Netflix stars Nick and Vanessa Lachey list $8.1 million L.A. home they bought from Naomi Osaka
item.description: TV stars Nick and Vanessa Lachey are bidding farewell to their longtime “dream home,” listing the Tarzana property for $8.1 million as they prepare to leave California altogether.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
